role_evidence.quote: P134 cells are CD44/CD133 dual-targeting CAR-T cells

agents.drug_class_hint: P134: CD44/CD133 dual-targeting CAR-T cells, intratumoral or intraventricular via Ommaya reservoir

biomarkers.biomarker_other: CD44 or CD133 tumour expression by IHC

source_quote.quote: Positive CD44 or CD133 antigen expression in tumor tissue confirmed by IHC, defined as ≥1% of tumor cells showing positive CD44 or CD133 IHC staining, regardless of intensity (applicable only in Phase II dose expansion study).

coder_notes: Only intervention is a CAR-T cell therapy (excluded type), so S6 fails with excluded_intervention_type. CD44/CD133 expression is required only for the Phase II expansion (not a separately registered arm), coded enrichment; it matches the CAR-T target but the CAR-T is not a candidate, so candidate_matched = false. CSF CAR-T cytokinetics concern the excluded cell therapy, not a pharmacological candidate, so tumour_pk_planned = no.
